name: FormSculpt
title: 3D sculpting and modeling on your own machine
summary: FormSculpt is a free, open-source 3D sculpting and modeling app with a Rust engine, quad remesh, UVs, painting, a path render and agent control over MCP.
lede: FormSculpt is the Form family's sculpting and modeling app: a Rust sculpting engine driving a TypeScript viewport, a FastAPI engine service and a Tauri 2 desktop build. Every action is a keyed command in one registry, so the interface, the keyboard and outside agents all drive the same engine.
runs_on: macOS, Windows and Linux (desktop build targets: all); also in a browser
checks: Sculpts with brushes, layers, dynamic topology, voxel remesh and a field-aligned quad remesh that follows the form and its hard edges.
Models with ZModeler-style quad actions, creased edges, retopology patches and UVs including UDIM tiles.
Paints into textures and renders with a path-traced render, a denoiser, spot lights and AgX and Neutral tone maps.
Hands work to other apps through GoF: a folder and a gof.json manifest, with GLB, FBX and Substance 3D Painter packages.

facts.dd: Rust engine workspace in native/, with a vanilla TypeScript and Vite client and a FastAPI service
.fsc files, with a file association in the desktop shell
26, English by default, switched live in View > Language

chapters.title: Brushes, layers and remesh
chapters.text: Brushes include Clay strips, Elastic, Polish, Layer, Nudge and Stamp, with stroke filters, symmetry and nested repeaters. Voxel remesh and a field-aligned quad remesh steered by guide curves rebuild the topology.

chapters.title: Quad modeling, retopology and UDIM
chapters.text: ZModeler-style actions, edge loops, creases and retopology templates for a head, a sphere or a whole skeleton work on quads. The UV view adds charts, sew, cut, texel density and UDIM tiles.

chapters.title: Claude in the window
chapters.text: A terminal dock holds real shells, a Claude Code tab already connected to FormSculpt's tools and a Chat tab that sculpts through the same tools. Each change is one undo step.

features.title: One command registry
bullets: Dotted id, MCP name, JSON schema, annotations, label and keys
Exports the catalogue the UI, MCP server and agent skills read
Menu bar and right-click menus built from the registry
Mod+K palette over every command and a Mod+/ shortcut editor

features.title: Rust engine
features.text: One Cargo workspace does the sculpting, remeshing and baking, and compiles to WebAssembly so the window works with no service.
bullets: ./formsculpt engine build, check or wasm
The browser engine is used when no service answers, or at ?engine=wasm

features.title: Sculpting
features.text: Brushes with stroke options and filters.
bullets: Elastic, Polish, Layer, Nudge, Stamp and Clay strips brushes
Stroke filters: front faces only, connected only, same face group, keep sharp edges
Alpha stretch, rotation, tiling and saved tool presets
Nested repeaters and scattering copies over a surface

features.title: Topology
bullets: Dynamic topology modes (speed, balanced, quality) and methods
Voxel remesh that fuses overlapping parts into one watertight piece
Field-aligned quad remesh with guide curves and density painted in red and blue
Decimation that keeps paint, face groups and UVs

features.title: Modeling and retopology
features.text: ZModeler-style quad actions with a hover highlight.
bullets: Edge loops, edge extrude, face inset, extrude and delete
Creased edges that stay sharp through subdivision
Retopology patch library and whole-object templates for a head, a sphere or a skeleton

features.title: UVs and UDIM
features.text: A UV view with automatic charts and a UV checker.
bullets: UV sew, cut and straighten, texel density readout and equalizing
Conformal UV relax with pins
UDIM tiles, per-tile bakes and export with one material per tile

features.title: Painting
features.text: Vertex paint and painting straight into a texture.
bullets: Paint layers with 23 blend modes
Spotlight: images held over the view that paint or sculpt through the camera
Roughness, metalness and opacity drawn in lit shading
Eyedropper and material presets

features.title: Viewport and render
features.text: A studio viewport and a path render.
bullets: Gradient backdrop with vignette and an infinite anti-aliased floor grid (Shift+P toggles the grid)
Bounce light, screen-space reflections, AgX and Neutral tone maps
Spot lights with colour temperature in kelvin
Path render with a denoiser, refraction and renders up to 4K

features.title: Layouts
features.text: Several interface layouts, including a tablet layout and the ZUI Layout.
bullets: Floating toolbars built from any command
Layout files carry the interface arrangement to another browser
Themes: dark, light, high contrast, or following NodeMode

features.title: Scene
features.text: A scene hierarchy with objects under objects or empty groups.
bullets: Instance, Un-instance and Sync Instances
Reorder by dragging rows in the object list
Named camera views kept with the scene and in projects

features.title: GoF and file exchange
features.text: GoF is FormSculpt's own hand-off to other apps.
bullets: One folder and a gof.json manifest; edits saved there come back
GLB for Blender, Unreal Engine and FormSurface, FBX for Unity, a Substance 3D Painter package
A live two-way link with Blender through an add-on
Print check, with STL and 3MF in millimetres

features.title: Agents and terminal
features.text: A terminal dock under the viewport (Mod+J).
bullets: Claude Code tab (Shift+Mod+J) running your own sign-in, already connected to FormSculpt's tools
Chat tab (Alt+Mod+J) that sculpts through the same tools, each change one undo step
./formsculpt agents install registers FormSculpt for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor

features.title: Local, zero-flash shell
features.text: Local only by default: Vite and uvicorn bind 127.0.0.1.
bullets: Theme applied before first paint and reserved layout
In-place text updates only
26 languages, switched live with no reload

parity.summary: Re-traced in its own tree at 1.18.2, FormSculpt reaches 94.5 of 97 rows against ZBrush, with quad remesh and texture-map painting now full.

docs.agents: ./formsculpt agents install registers FormSculpt for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json start ./formsculpt mcp, and the formsculpt-modeling skill teaches the tools.

topics.title: Quick Start
topics.text: The README gives requirements and commands for macOS, Linux and Windows (formsculpt_oc_install.bat, formsculpt.bat) and a table of the frontend, backend and preview URLs.

topics.title: Desktop build
topics.text: ./build_app builds and bundles the app, logged to build_app.log, with flags --clean, --install and --no-install; Windows produces msi and nsis installers.

topics.title: Configuration
topics.text: backend/.env sets FSC_HOST, FSC_PORT, FSC_CORS_ORIGINS and FSC_DIST.

topics.title: Shortcuts and palette
topics.text: Mod+K opens a palette over every command and Mod+/ opens the shortcut editor.

topics.title: Testing
topics.text: ./formsculpt test runs the engine and service suites; ./formsculpt test e2e drives a booted window in Chromium under 4x throttling.

topics.title: Status
topics.text: The README lists what is not yet built, such as cloth brushes, HD geometry and binary USD, and notes that macOS and Windows bundles were not run.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain
The desktop app builds on Windows
build_app.bat bundles the Blender add-on and the Unreal and Unity receivers
Scripts check out with LF line endings and .bat files with CRLF on every system
A window smoke test runs in CI, and the splash logo no longer moves when the line under it arrives
